units.source_text: 皇太子的冠礼，于是月二十后某日完成。

en.t: The Crown Prince's coming-of-age ceremony was completed on a certain day after the twentieth of that month.

units.source_text: 皇太子年仅十三，却已长大成人。

en.t: The Crown Prince was only thirteen, yet he had already grown into adulthood.

units.source_text: 因此高官贵族争欲遣送女儿入宫奉侍。

en.t: For this reason, high officials and nobles competed to send their daughters into the palace to serve him.

units.source_text: 但闻源氏太政大臣已有此志，并且排场特别隆重，

en.t: But when they heard that Genji, the Chancellor, already had such an intention, and that his arrangements were especially splendid,

units.source_text: 左大臣及左大将等都觉得自己的女儿无法争宠，便打消了这个念头。

en.t: the Minister of the Left, the Left Captain, and the others all felt that their own daughters could not compete for favor, and gave up the idea.

units.source_text: 源氏闻之，说道：“如此反而怠慢了。

en.t: When Genji heard this, he said, "That would actually be negligent of us.

units.source_text: 后宫之中，必须有许多美人争艳斗媚，

en.t: In the inner palace there ought to be many beauties competing in charm and loveliness,

units.source_text: 较量分寸之差，这才富有意趣。

en.t: and it is precisely in comparing the slightest differences among them that the true interest lies.

units.source_text: 大家把千金小姐笼闭在家里，岂不太可惜么？”

en.t: Would it not be far too regrettable for everyone to keep their precious daughters shut away at home?"

units.source_text: 他就叫自己的女儿延期入宫。

en.t: He therefore had his own daughter's entry into the palace postponed.

units.source_text: 诸人本当静候明石小女公子先行，然后依次送女儿入宫。

en.t: The others had originally meant to wait quietly for the young lady of Akashi to enter first, and then send their daughters to the palace in order.

units.source_text: 如今闻此消息，左大臣便遣送家里的三女公子入宫，人称之为丽景殿。

en.t: Now that he had heard this news, the Minister of the Left sent his third daughter into the palace, and people came to call her Reikeiden.
